Question
========
What does commodification mean?

Answerlist
----------
* Goods, services, and opportunities are increasingly allocated to those who can pay
* Public services are expanded to all residents
* Commodity prices rise on world markets
* Firms produce more standardised goods

Solution
========
When essential goods such as health, housing, or education must be purchased rather than being provided as a right, income inequality becomes inequality of capabilities.

Answerlist

* True

* False
* False
